title: OPMS common definitions
description: Shared definitions reused by every OPMS object schema.

Version.description: Dataset or change-set version label, e.g. 2026-11-23.1.

LocalPoint.description: [x, y, z] metres in the facility frame (x east, y north, z up).

LocalPolygon.description: Corners in the facility frame, counter-clockwise. At least four points. The ring need not repeat the first point. z is the elevation of the level.

Geometry.description: Geometry in a local frame. Coordinates are LocalPoints.

type.description: Geometry kind in the facility frame. Point: one position. LineString: an ordered path. Polygon: a counter-clockwise ring. The ring need not repeat the first point.

coordinates.description: Positions as LocalPoint values, metres in the facility frame (x east, y north, z up).

TimeWindow.description: Local-time window in the site's IANA timezone.

days.description: Days the window applies, in the site's timezone. mo Monday, tu Tuesday, we Wednesday, th Thursday, fr Friday, sa Saturday, su Sunday, ph a public holiday in the site's jurisdiction.

start.description: Local start time, HH:MM, from 00:00 to 23:59. The site's IANA timezone applies.

end.description: Local end time, HH:MM. 24:00 means the end of the local day.

VehicleLimits.description: Physical limits. The lowest value along a route wins.

max_height_m.description: Highest vehicle that may pass, in metres. A missing value means the limit is unknown, so an oversize vehicle must not assume it can pass.

max_width_m.description: Widest vehicle that may pass, in metres.

max_length_m.description: Longest vehicle that may pass, in metres.

max_mass_kg.description: Heaviest vehicle that may pass, in kilograms.

vehicle_classes.description: Vehicle classes allowed. car, motorcycle, van, light_truck, bus. An empty or missing list does not grant access.

ExternalRefs.description: Links to other standards' identifiers instead of copying their geometry.

lanelet2_ids.description: Lanelet2 primitive identifiers this feature corresponds to. Geometry stays in the other map.

lane.description: OpenDRIVE lane id on that road. Sign follows OpenDRIVE (left positive, right negative in the road direction).

object.description: OpenDRIVE object id, when the feature is an object rather than a lane.

opendrive.description: OpenDRIVE identifiers for the same feature. OPMS does not copy the OpenDRIVE geometry.

osm.description: OpenStreetMap elements, each node/<id>, way/<id> or relation/<id>.

indoorgml_cell.description: IndoorGML cell identifier for this space.

apds_id.description: APDS identifier when a single id is enough. Prefer the place, subplace, identified-area or space fields when the level is known.

apds_place_id.description: APDS Place id (Place > SubplaceElement > IdentifiedArea > Space hierarchy is reused, not duplicated).

apds_subplace_id.description: APDS SubplaceElement id. The APDS hierarchy is referenced, not copied.

apds_space_id.description: APDS Space id, typically one bay.

maze_id.description: Reserved: identifier in a MAZE facility map (interoperability is an open question).

iso5206_id.description: Identifier in an ISO/TS 5206-1 core data model instance.

Provenance.description: Where a fact came from and when it was last confirmed.

source.description: Who produced the fact. survey: a deliberate survey. operator: the car-park operator. authority: a public authority. vehicle_crowd: many vehicles. sensor: a fixed sensor. import: copied from another dataset. consolidation: the repository's merged result.

confidence.description: Producer's confidence, from 0 (none) to 1 (certain). This is not the evidence agreement score.

contribution_ids.description: Contributions that support this record (crowdsourced features).

change_set_id.description: Change set that last touched this record.

Evidence.description: Per-feature multi-source evidence kept by the consolidating repository.

n_observations.description: How many observations support the current consensus.

n_distinct_contributors.description: How many different contributor organisations those observations came from.

n_distinct_vehicles.description: How many distinct vehicle pseudonyms those observations came from. Not a count of VINs.

agreement_score.description: Weighted share of observations consistent with the consensus.

positional_sigma_m.description: Estimated positional spread of the observations, one standard deviation, in metres.

status.description: Evidence state. candidate: seen but not yet reviewed. provisional: usable with caution. verified: accepted by the repository. disputed: observations disagree. retired: no longer current.

Lifecycle.description: Feature lifecycle. Retired features are announced by a tombstone in a ChangeSet.

LicenceTerms.description: Usage terms for a dataset, feature or contribution.

custom_terms_uri.description: URI of custom licence terms, used when there is no SPDX identifier. One of spdx_id or this URI is required.

commercial_use.description: True when the terms allow commercial use.

attribution_required.description: True when users must attribute the source.

redistribution.description: Whether the data may be passed on. allowed: yes. restricted: only under extra conditions in the terms. prohibited: no.

derivative_works.description: Whether modified copies are allowed. allowed, restricted, or prohibited.

ai_training_use.description: Whether the data may be used to train models. allowed, restricted, prohibited, or unspecified when the terms are silent.

retention_days.description: How many days a recipient may keep a copy. 0 means no retained copy.

sublicensable.description: True when a recipient may grant the same rights to someone else.

sublicence_chain.description: Contributor or repository ids that show how the licence was passed on.

QualityTier.description: Declared quality for a facility or feature. Cars map their ODD to a minimum tier. Tier 2 and tier 3 are owner-verified or higher: the facility must include a verification with role owner, status confirmed, and dataset_version equal to the dataset version. The verification does not raise the tier by itself. It is required before those tiers may be declared. Drive edges and accessible paths on an owner-verified facility must carry a centreline.

accuracy_class.description: Intended use, matching the tier. indicative: display and planning. adas: driver-supervised assistance. supervised_self_park: supervised self-parking. driverless: driverless operation. Numeric accuracy targets in the spec are proposals, not regulator requirements.

completeness_pct.description: Share of expected features present, from 0 to 100 percent.

certification_ids.description: Certification records that support this tier.

ApprovalStatus.description: Facility owner or operator consent for mapping and use.

owner_consent.description: Operator or owner consent. unknown: not asked. granted: given. denied: refused. conditional: given only for the listed scope.

granted_by.description: Organisation that granted or refused consent. An organisation label, not a person's name.

scope.description: What consent covers. geometry_only: the map geometry. publish: publishing it. driverless_use: driverless operation. commercial_use: commercial use.

signage.description: Mapping or AVP signage is posted on site.

dispute_contact.description: Public contact for corrections or takedown (organisation role or URL).

Profile.description: Cumulative dataset profile. static-core is the default and requires no live data.

BayAccessibility.description: Accessible-bay attributes. Dimensions are as built; standard_ref says what the facility was designed or audited against.

standard_ref.description: e.g. AS 2890.6:2022 (verify the edition in force).

bay_width_m.description: As-built width of the bay, in metres.

bay_length_m.description: As-built length of the bay, in metres.

side.description: Which side of the bay the shared zone is on, as the driver looks out of the bay. none, left, right, or both.

width_m.description: Width of the shared zone, in metres.

length_m.description: Length of the shared zone along the bay, in metres.

rear_length_m.description: Extra shared length behind the bay, in metres.

shared_between_bays.description: True when neighbouring accessible bays share one zone.

shared_zone.description: Marked shared area beside or behind the bay, used for unloading a wheelchair or ramp.

kerb_ramp.description: True when a kerb ramp serves this bay.

material.description: Surface material. asphalt, concrete, pavers, gravel, or other.

slip_resistant.description: True when the surface is treated or finished to resist slipping when wet.

surface.description: Walking surface of the bay and its shared zone.

gradient_pct.description: Maximum gradient across the bay and shared zone.

headroom_m.description: Minimum headroom over the bay and its approach.

high_roof_van_ok.description: Headroom and approach suit high-roof wheelchair vans.

loading.description: Clear space for ramps and lifts.

rear_ramp_clearance_m.description: Clear length behind the vehicle for a rear ramp, in metres.

side_lift_clearance_m.description: Clear width beside the vehicle for a side lift, in metres.

distance_to_accessible_entrance_m.description: Walking distance from the bay to the nearest accessible entrance, in metres.

rest_point_on_path.description: True when there is a place to rest on the path from this bay to the entrance.

permit_scheme.description: adps = Australian Disability Parking Scheme permit.

bollard.description: Bollard in the shared zone to keep it clear.

method.description: How the audit was done. survey: measured on site. self_report: the operator's own report. crowd: reported by contributors.

audit.description: How and when the accessible-bay attributes were last checked.

HandoverAccessibility.description: Accessibility of a drop-off or pick-up zone.

kerbside_transfer_space_m.description: Clear width beside the vehicle for a wheelchair transfer or ramp.

kerb_ramp.description: True when a kerb ramp is at the drop-off or pick-up.

step_free_to_destination.description: True when a person can reach the destination from here without steps.

sheltered.description: True when people waiting are under cover.

seating.description: True when there is seating for people waiting.

assistance_point.description: True when staff or a call point can help a passenger here.

tactile_marking.description: True when tactile paving or another tactile mark is present.

lighting.description: Lighting where people wait. none, partial, or good.

wait_time_allowance_s.description: Extra standing time allowed when a passenger needs assistance.

PublicationTerms.description: How openly the dataset is published so councils, disability organisations and non-AV apps can use it.

public_url.description: Public web page for this dataset.

api_endpoint.description: HTTP endpoint that serves the dataset.

formats.description: Formats offered. json, geojson, opendrive, lanelet2, indoorgml, or apds.

bulk_download.description: True when the whole dataset can be downloaded in one file.

non_av_use_allowed.description: Usable by people driving themselves or being driven, not only by automated vehicles.

accessible_documentation.description: True when the documentation of this dataset meets an accessibility target such as WCAG 2.2.

update_frequency.description: How often the published copy changes. realtime, daily, weekly, monthly, or on_change.

accessibility_contact.description: Contact for accessibility questions. An organisation mailbox or role, not a private person's name.

Verification.description: One check of a feature against the real place. Stores the review, not the evidence file. No personal data.

role.description: Reviewer role. An organisation role, not a person's name.

status.description: confirmed: matches the place. incorrect: the record is wrong. missing: not there on the ground. not-checked: explicitly skipped.

note.description: Short note. No names, plates or diagnoses.

evidence_ref.description: Pointer to evidence kept outside the map (audit id or URL). Not the evidence itself.

dataset_version.description: Dataset version the reviewer looked at.
